title: Smoked Syrian Skewers
description: Vegan skewers with a smoky twist, perfect for a summer evening. The flavors of the Syrian spices complement the smokiness of the grilled vegetables.

ingredients.name: aromatic spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Cut the smoked eggplant and Syrian pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Thread the eggplant, pepper, and aromatic spices onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with salt to taste.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
